findings.description:
Reentrancy in WalletLibrary.confirm(bytes32) (dataset/positive/difficulty_stratified/original/tier3/contracts/ds_t3_022.sol#273-287):
	External calls:
	- ! m_txs[_h].to.call.value(m_txs[_h].value)(m_txs[_h].data) (dataset/positive/difficulty_stratified/original/tier3/contracts/ds_t3_022.sol#279)
	State variables written after the call(s):
	- delete m_txs[_h] (dataset/positive/difficulty_stratified/original/tier3/contracts/ds_t3_022.sol#284)
	WalletLibrary.m_txs (dataset/positive/difficulty_stratified/original/tier3/contracts/ds_t3_022.sol#399) can be used in cross function reentrancies:
	- WalletLibrary.clearPending() (dataset/positive/difficulty_stratified/original/tier3/contracts/ds_t3_022.sol#363-374)
	- WalletLibrary.confirm(bytes32) (dataset/positive/difficulty_stratified/original/tier3/contracts/ds_t3_022.sol#273-287)
	- WalletLibrary.execute(address,uint256,bytes) (dataset/positive/difficulty_stratified/original/tier3/contracts/ds_t3_022.sol#237-262)
WalletLibrary.kill(address) (dataset/positive/difficulty_stratified/original/tier3/contracts/ds_t3_022.sol#229-231) allows anyone to destruct the contract

Wallet.m_owners (dataset/positive/difficulty_stratified/original/tier3/contracts/ds_t3_022.sol#468) is never initialized. It is used in:
	- Wallet.getOwner(uint256) (dataset/positive/difficulty_stratified/original/tier3/contracts/ds_t3_022.sol#441-443)
WalletLibrary.confirm(bytes32).created (dataset/positive/difficulty_stratified/original/tier3/contracts/ds_t3_022.sol#275) is a local variable never initialized
WalletLibrary.execute(address,uint256,bytes).created (dataset/positive/difficulty_stratified/original/tier3/contracts/ds_t3_022.sol#241) is a local variable never initialized
Modifier WalletLibrary.onlymanyowners(bytes32) (dataset/positive/difficulty_stratified/original/tier3/contracts/ds_t3_022.sol#97-100) does not always execute _; or revert
Modifier WalletLibrary.onlyowner() (dataset/positive/difficulty_stratified/original/tier3/contracts/ds_t3_022.sol#90-93) does not always execute _; or revert

Reentrancy in WalletLibrary.execute(address,uint256,bytes) (dataset/positive/difficulty_stratified/original/tier3/contracts/ds_t3_022.sol#237-262):
	External calls:
	- ! _to.call.value(_value)(_data) (dataset/positive/difficulty_stratified/original/tier3/contracts/ds_t3_022.sol#245)
	Event emitted after the call(s):
	- SingleTransact(msg.sender,_value,_to,_data,created) (dataset/positive/difficulty_stratified/original/tier3/contracts/ds_t3_022.sol#248)

Reentrancy in WalletLibrary.confirm(bytes32) (dataset/positive/difficulty_stratified/original/tier3/contracts/ds_t3_022.sol#273-287):
	External calls:
	- ! m_txs[_h].to.call.value(m_txs[_h].value)(m_txs[_h].data) (dataset/positive/difficulty_stratified/original/tier3/contracts/ds_t3_022.sol#279)
	Event emitted after the call(s):
	- MultiTransact(msg.sender,_h,m_txs[_h].value,m_txs[_h].to,m_txs[_h].data,created) (dataset/positive/difficulty_stratified/original/tier3/contracts/ds_t3_022.sol#283)

WalletLibrary.underLimit(uint256) (dataset/positive/difficulty_stratified/original/tier3/contracts/ds_t3_022.sol#345-358) uses timestamp for comparisons
	Dangerous comparisons:
	- today() > m_lastDay (dataset/positive/difficulty_stratified/original/tier3/contracts/ds_t3_022.sol#347)
